brief:
The Palestinian Red Crescent Society said its teams in Jericho were treating two people wounded by live ammunition in an attack by settlers in the al-Deik area, the Maan Wire reported. A young man was shot in the thigh and a woman was shot in the head, the organization said.

Both victims were being transported to hospital for further treatment.

title: Red Crescent treats two shot by settlers in Jericho
